note: REAL master-bedroom suite, Floor 2 LEFT bay, PRJ-2026-002 (anonymized: no client/firm/unit identifiers). Re-derived 2026-07-04 to REPLACE the loose bedroom_suite.json approximation the owner flagged (designer round-2: 'ผิดตั้งแต่การถอดแบบ ... layout เพี้ยน'). METHOD + PROVENANCE (honesty is load-bearing): (1) DIMENSIONS ARE AUTHORITATIVE from the drafter's WRITTEN dimensions on I-26-001-CAD-02-3D (raw-local; title block 'WRITTEN DIMENSIONS TAKE PRECEDENCE'): bay 5500 wide x (2850 + 2950 + 700) deep = 6500 total; the south 700 strip is an OPEN TERRACE (dashed, 2 planters) BEYOND the south glazing, so the conditioned INTERIOR is 5500 x 5800 (core fix: the old spec treated all 6500 as interior + omitted the terrace). SIZES are BF codes (cm): vanity BF10.250 (2500), west wardrobe BF11.320, NE dressing BF09-3.330; bed labelled 7'x6.5' = 2134 x 1981 (old spec used a 6ft/2000 bed — corrected). (2) ZONES ARE AUTHORITATIVE: ensuite NORTH-WEST (tub+double-vanity+WC+shower), sleeping zone SOUTH facing the terrace glazing, dressing NORTH-EAST. (3) EXACT FURNITURE XY + ORIENTATION + the entry-door wall are DESIGN JUDGEMENT, not traced — the CAD furniture is in a mixed-scale/mirrored/anonymized-block tangle whose loose-insert frame is squashed (unusable for positions), and freehand raster tracing is the exact error mode that produced the old drift. Furniture is placed to be ERGONOMICALLY CORRECT (passes clearance Gate 0 + placement_logic FUNCTION gate) within the authoritative envelope. OPEN QUESTION for the owner/designer: BED ORIENTATION. This spec models the bed N-S (headboard north, foot toward the south terrace glazing). But the CAD 'bed bench 1' insert carries rot=270 (bench long-axis N-S), which implies the bed FOOT is a vertical edge => bed long-axis E-W (headboard on a side wall). The raster pillows read north-ish (N-S). The two disagree; confirm which before this gates a deliverable. The old spec's floor-standing foot TV is REMOVED (no TV symbol in the master; bed foot faces the terrace glazing where a TV cannot go). Ensuite door modelled as SLIDING (space-saving, common) — no swing arc. Coord frame: mm, origin SW corner of the interior, x east, y north, y=0 = south glazing wall to terrace, front = -Y at rot 0.
